analysis.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', gdate_happened) AS "الشهر", count(*) AS "عدد المخالفات" FROM "ds_4ea4f575f5f44fc19ccfff6b6c326cae" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
